description: ČR 2030 19.5.1 Počet kilometrů cyklotras v jednotlivých krajích, okresech a ORP is a dataset listed in Czech National Open Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ministerstvo životního prostředí. Data set of the Sustainable Development Indicator of the Czech Republic 2030 19.5.1: The number of kilometres of cycle routes. Created from the underlying data of the Czech Statistical Office. Coverage: Ministerstvo životního prostředí. The portal shows the English title as "Czech Republic 2030 19.5.1 Number of kilometres of cycle routes in individual regions, districts and ORP" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ministerstvo životního prostředí. Its keywords include cyklistická infrastruktura, cyklistika. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/00164801/b12daed837172fa07a4cda0a25c54fa5/distribuce/8d8e93f6199f1e4648bebfe844ab85ba/podmínky-užití). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nkod-opendata-cz.
